title: Colored brass bands and Mardi Gras parades
summary: Black bands like O'Quinn's are mentioned; few were hired for parades. He disparages modern school bands.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: I was wondering, did you hear any other colored bands, were there any colored grass bands in those days? Well, they had, uh,
O'Quinn, O'Quinn and D Blair, that was a nigga band, brass band. O'Quinn and D Blair. But there wasn't many colored bands that I knew of. Well, they didn't hire them.

colored bands in the Mardi Gras parades you see. Now today they hire all them school boys bands. Well them boys you know they don't play music like you can tell or listen at them. It's just like over at the school here, they got a teacher teaching all them boys, about 25 boys and playing, learning to play music and you can hear more false notes and you can shake a stick at them. You understand? Now one boy might be all right, he plays quite all right but the other fella's man he's making a murder.
